reason: The original protocol handles a missing bar fail-closed. With Sina data, 510500 has no bars on 2015-04-13 and 2015-04-14 (suspension around its share conversion) and 159915 has no bar on 2021-02-08 (cause unverified). Fail-closed aborts every run that holds these ETFs on those days, so the strategy cannot be evaluated at all.
status_under_original_protocol: Strategy runs (CAP_DEF_M, BASE_M_CN) NOT RUN due to missing bars. This status is reported alongside the amended results.

rules.verification_first: For each missing (symbol, session), try one independent source (e.g. another akshare endpoint such as Tencent/Eastmoney, or THS) for the unadjusted open and close of that session. If both are found and are consistent with neighbouring Sina closes (no unexplained jump > 10%), use them, convert with the same adjustment factor, and record the source per bar. Otherwise treat the session as a suspension.
rules.suspension_valuation: On a suspended session the symbol is valued at its last available adjusted close (carry-forward). No price for a later date is ever used.
rules.suspension_trading: A rebalance whose execution session has any held or target symbol suspended is postponed, as a whole, to the next session on which all held and target symbols have bars. The signal (weights) is unchanged; execution is still strictly after the signal close. Postponed rebalances are counted and listed.
rules.signals: Signals are computed only from available closes up to the signal close; a suspended symbol's carried-forward close is not treated as a new observation for momentum or trend.
rules.scope: Applies identically to CAP_DEF_M, BASE_M_CN, CSI300_BH and CN_60_40 and to both cost settings.
rules.no_other_changes: Universe, groups, rule parameters, costs, cash, benchmarks, metrics and success criteria are unchanged.
